m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Who dares enter the Baron's private retreat? I'm afraid he's not feeling well and cannot entertain guests now. You'll have to come back.
Hmm. I think maybe you guys just didn't get the memo. The Baron's no longer the boss around here. His daughter, Teddy, yeah, she's taken over.
Blasphemy! Such words shall not be uttered! Guards! Silence them!
So... no offense, Master, but I would think you've earned a reputation. Doesn't anyone ever just surrender? No? I was afraid you'd say that.
Must it really come to this? I told you from the start - the Baron is ill. Can you not just humor him? My new treatment will fix everything.
Sorry doc, the sick card only works for so long. I think the Baron's burned through his excuses at this point. Don't you, Master?
I cannot allow you to interfere with my patient's progress. No more bedside manners from this physician. The surgical gloves are off!
Makes you wonder, doesn't it? I mean, would you want a doctor like that treating you? People like that should be licensed or something.
Welcome to the Pit of Despair! Haha! Don't even think... h-h-hruh! Don't even think about trying to escape from here.
Uh... hello? We're not trying to escape. We're trying to convince you to step down peacefully and let your daughter take over.
Don't even think... h-h-hruh! Don't think about that either. A Qhitten to run House Calixco? Never! Haha! I'll crush you... into kibbles and bits!
I'm feeling a little... woozy! You'd beat down a sick Qhat? Shame on you! I'll be back! You haven't seen the last of Baron Hairkonnen!
Actually, I'm pretty sure we have. Nashkurgal sent word to the Mongus. Soon as the Baron leaves the Manor, he gets an escort... to Istanboa.
So it's done then? He's gone, and I'm in charge? Wow. Imagine that. I didn't see this coming when I was rotting away down in that prison!
Father, I know we didn't get much quality time after you shipped me off to a Snakish Prison, but I'm trying to be as nice as possible here.
As your chief advisor, Baron, I do advise you to pass the leadership on to Teddy. Considering your condition, it's what's best for the House.
Considering my... h-h-hruh! My condition? Doctor Yooh says... h-h-hruh! He says his new treatment will cure me. This Qhitten has no right!
No. If you want to take leadership of... h-h-hruh! Of House Calixco, you'll have to rip it out of cold, sickened claws! I'll be in MY retreat!
After hearing of your exploits in Istanboa, Wizard, I can think of none better suited to finish this than you. Try not to make too big a mess.
Oh, don't worry. I'll go along too. We'll keep things tidy, won't we, Master? All right. Let's go.
I know, I know. You don't even have to say it. You've done enough for me already. I can't face him though. Please, just... just banish him.
